title: SLA definition
text: SLA attainment is the share of support tickets resolved within the promised time. Compare the same period and calculate from ticket counts, not the average of regional percentages.

title: West delivery incident note
text: During the current week, the West delivery queue had a routing change and a two-day staffing gap. These are investigation leads, not proven causes of any SLA change.

title: Escalation playbook
text: If SLA falls, identify the segment with the largest excess late-ticket count, verify sample size, inspect queue and staffing changes, and ask an owner to confirm the operational cause.

title: Data handling policy
text: This training dataset is fictional. The assistant may read local sample tickets and notes only. It must not send messages, edit records, browse private systems, or execute generated code.
